query:
SELECT c.id AS "case_id!: _", c.kind AS "kind!", c.subject_revision AS "subject_revision!", c.opened_at AS "opened_at!: _", h.number AS "hypothesis_number!", h.title AS "hypothesis_title!", t.slug AS "track_slug!", a.sequence AS "attempt_sequence?", e.front_matter ->> 'verdict' AS "verdict?", f.stage AS "failure_stage?", f.code AS "failure_code?", f.reason AS "failure_reason?", c.origin AS "origin!" FROM review_cases c
            JOIN hypotheses h ON h.id = c.hypothesis_id
            JOIN tracks t ON t.id = h.track_id
            LEFT JOIN attempts a ON a.id = c.attempt_id
            LEFT JOIN phase_outputs e ON e.id = c.evidence_id
            LEFT JOIN attempt_failures f ON f.id = c.failure_id
            WHERE c.project_id = $1 AND c.state = 'pending'
            ORDER BY c.opened_at, c.id
            LIMIT $2
